About the clinic

Clear explanations, unhurried care.

Cadent is an orthodontist and dental clinic in Wakad, Pune, serving patients of all ages with braces, clear aligners and dental implant care. Our approach is simple: understand your concern, explain the options honestly, and agree on a plan you feel comfortable with before any treatment begins.

Each consultation is a conversation. Ask as many questions as you need; we will answer them clearly.

Treatments

Areas of care

Every treatment starts with a consultation. Your options depend on your examination, goals and preferences.

01

Fixed orthodontics

Braces-based correction using fixed mechanotherapy, for crowding, gaps, spacing and bite alignment.

02

Clear aligners

Removable, transparent aligners as an option for suitable patients, planned after assessment.

03

Lingual orthodontics

Braces placed on the inner surface of the teeth, for patients who prefer a less visible option.

04

Oral implantology

Tooth replacement planning and implant care, assessed and discussed during your consultation.

05

Children & teens

Early orthodontic assessment and guidance for growing smiles.

06

Adult orthodontics

Discreet options for adults who want to improve their smile and bite at any stage of life.

FAQs

Common questions

How do I book an appointment?

Message us on WhatsApp, call the clinic, or email cadentclinic@gmail.com. We will confirm a suitable time with you.

What should I bring to my first visit?

Bring any previous dental records or X-rays you have, a list of current medicines, and any questions you would like to discuss.

Do you treat children?

Yes. We see patients of all ages, including children and teenagers for early orthodontic assessment.

Which languages do you speak?

Dr. Kumar speaks English, Hindi and Marathi.

What are your opening hours?

Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 1:30 PM and 4:30 PM to 8:30 PM. Sunday is by appointment only.
